config.name: Tidal Thames
config._note: Centreline: OS Open Rivers. Water: OS OpenMap Local (TidalWater, SurfaceWater_Area). Bed levels: calibrated against the tideway gauges (see calibration); still not surveyed. Not modelled: Richmond half-tide lock and weir, Thames Barrier closures. Teddington Lock Tail is excluded from calibration and Richmond is fitted on high water only (Richmond half-tide lock and weir hold up low water).

calibration.method: coordinate search on bed profile points and Manning's n; objective: high/low water errors and high-water timing at the tideway gauges
calibration.boundary: Tilbury recorded tide; Thames at Kingston flow
